data.name: Diego De Almagro Punta Arenas
data.address: Av. Cristobal Colón 1290, Punta Arenas, Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena, Chile
data.description:
Overlooking the Strait of Magellan, this unpretentious hotel is 1 km from the Museo Regional de Magallanes and 2 km from the Cementerio Municipal Sara Braun.
Relaxed rooms offer free Wi-Fi, cable TV and safes, as well as minibars. Room service is available.
A breakfast buffet is complimentary. There’s also an informal restaurant and meeting space. Other amenities include an indoor pool, a gym and a sauna, plus a business center. Limited parking is available.
